items.title: Systems thinking
items.body: Requirements and interfaces come before parts. We study the environment and validate assumptions before choosing a solution.

items.title: Indigenous capability
items.body: We build our own understanding of every critical subsystem, and we are clear about what we designed and what we bought.

items.title: Evidence over opinion
items.body: We describe our work by the evidence behind it: concept, simulation, bench test, flight test. If we have not measured it, we say so.

items.title: Responsible by design
items.body: Our defence-related work is lawful, authorised and keeps people in charge of decisions. We never overstate what our systems can do.
